item.title: Ursuline wrestlers win three OFSAA medals
item.description: The Ursuline Lancers collected a school record three medals at the OFSAA wrestling championship this week in Peterborough.

item.title: LTVCA keeping an eye on watershed after heavy rain

item.title: Purple bench recognizes victims of intimate partner violence, trafficking
item.description: A purple bench has been unveiled in Chatham’s Zonta Park to support and honour victims of domestic violence, sexual assault and human trafficking. The Zonta Club of Chatham-Kent, Chatham-Kent Coordinating Committee to End Violence Against Women and Chatham Kent Women’s Centre were involved in the initiative, with a gathering held at the downtown park on […]

item.title: Nominations sought for this year's Black Excellence Awards
item.description: The Chatham-Kent Black Excellence Awards and Gala continues its recognition of outstanding community contributions through a collaborative partnership April 18, organizers say. item.title: Marchers celebrate International Women's Day
item.description: In a loud show of support for international women’s day, more than 100 people marched through the streets of downtown Chatham on Sunday. item.title: Clash causes single-vehicle crash, woman charged: Chatham-Kent police
item.description: A woman is charged after a clash between a driver and passenger led to a single-vehicle collision in Chatham Saturday night, said Chatham-Kent police.

item.title: Chatham Maroons start playoffs after winning regular-season crown
item.description: Assists aren’t awarded on shootout goals, but Chatham Maroons netminder Sammy DiBlasi deserves one.

item.title: PUC water, wastewaster master plan process will have public input
item.description: Chatham-Kent PUC is undertaking a water and wastewater master plan update study and will be seeking public input in the coming year.
